host.rebootMsg: Every app, terminal and remote session will close. NoCapOS will be back in a minute or two, and this page will reconnect automatically.
host.shutdownMsg: Every app and session will close and the machine will power off. You will need physical access (or your host's console) to turn it back on.
host.wifiOffMsg: If you're reaching NoCapOS over this machine's Wi-Fi, this page will lose its connection and you'll need local access to turn it back on.
host.netOffMsg: This disconnects every network on this machine. If you're using NoCapOS remotely, you'll lose access until someone turns networking back on locally.
host.ipMsg: {iface} will {desc}. If this page reaches NoCapOS through {iface}, it may disconnect briefly. You will be asked to keep the change; if you don't, it is undone automatically.
host.keepMsg: {iface} now uses the new settings. If anything stopped working, choose Revert, or wait and they will be undone.
host.reverted: Your previous network settings were restored
